newsitem.title: USA: Kansas fed cattle sales lightly tested - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas fed cattle sales lightly tested - USDA.

text.p: Trade very slow. Not enough slaughter steer or heifer sales confirmed for an adequate market test, USDA said. Inquiry moderate, demand light.
Sales confirmed on 100 slaughter heifers Thursday. For the week to date 141,000 head confirmed including 29,300 head or about 21 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink. Slaughter Heifers - Few Select and Choice 2-3 1050 lbs 63.00. Confirmed - 100
